validity.recommendation: Review the P1917/P1918/P1919 triple as one corridor; likely merge or document why three identical parallel 43 km / 30-in lines exist (no independent source distinguishes them).
validity.researcher_notes: P1917 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah), P1918 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 2) and P1919 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 3) are three identical GEM rows: each 43 km, 30 in, operating, ?->Al Hawiyah, owner Saudi Aramco. Independent industry sources confirm a Haradh-Khuff-to-Hawiyah dry-gas transmission corridor exists in concept (Khuff non-associated gas feeding the Hawiyah Gas Plant), but I could find NO independent source that distinguishes three separate parallel 43 km / 30-in lines, nor that confirms the '2'/'3' suffixed duplicates as physically distinct pipes. The only traces of three identical lines are GEM's own sister pages (and search-engine summaries of them) -- circular. offshore-technology.com (GlobalData) lists a single 'Haradh-Hawiyah Gas' line at 450 km / 36 in (a different object, closer to P3961 Madrakah-Al Hawiyah), not three 43 km/30-in lines. MEED and OGJ describe the Hawiyah NGL-recovery / Khuff-gas programme with different specs (48-in 25 km inlet/outlet lines; a 1,170 km E-W NGL line) and do not enumerate three 43 km lines. Verdict: existence of A Khuff->Hawiyah gas line is plausible, but the threefold split (P1919 specifically) is unsupported by independent evidence and is a strong duplicate / segment double-count candidate.

validity.recommendation: Correct EndState/Province from 'Makkah' to 'Eastern Province' (Ash Sharqiyah) -- Hawiyah/Haradh sit in the Ghawar complex in the Eastern Province, not Makkah.
validity.researcher_notes: Worklist records EndState/Province = 'Makkah' for the Al Hawiyah endpoint. This is wrong. The Hawiyah and Haradh gas facilities are part of the Ghawar field complex in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province (Al-Ahsa); the Hawiyah Gas Plant processes Khuff/Jawf non-associated gas there (Saudipedia, NS Energy/offshore-technology Ghawar profiles). 'Makkah' most likely results from geocoding to the unrelated town of Al Hawiyah near Taif (Makkah province). High confidence on the correction. NOTE: this province-correction confidence is high; it does not rescue the duplicate/spec concerns above.

validity.recommendation: Treat 43 km / 30 in as unverified GEM/OPEC-atlas-only figures; do not promote to high. Seek a primary Aramco/EPC spec before citing.
validity.researcher_notes: Length 43 km and diameter 30 in: I could not corroborate either against any independent source. The only harvested citation is OPEC ASB 2012 p.75 (verifier OK/200 but 'Saudi' is trivially present in any OPEC bulletin -- the PDF body could not be fetched to confirm a 43 km/30-in Haradh-Khuff-Hawiyah entry; paywalled/402 on detailed fetch). offshore-technology/GlobalData gives 450 km / 36 in for a 'Haradh-Hawiyah Gas' line -- materially DIFFERENT, not agreement. So the GEM specs are single-source (GEM/atlas) at best and conflict with the one independent industry figure. Flagging as a spec concern: numbers may be a mis-split or atlas artifact.

validity.recommendation: Keep Fuel=Gas and Owner=Saudi Aramco; classification as dry-gas transmission is correct in principle.
validity.researcher_notes: Classification (dry gas, not NGL) is correct: the Hawiyah Gas Plant processes Khuff/Jawf NON-ASSOCIATED gas, consistent with a 'Khuff gas' trunkline feeding it; this is a gas line, not an NGL line. Owner Saudi Aramco confirmed -- all Ghawar-complex Khuff/Hawiyah gas infrastructure is Aramco-owned/operated (Saudipedia, NS Energy Ghawar profile). Caveat: these confirmations are at the corridor/operator level and do not validate P1919 as a physically distinct third line (see duplicate concern).

fills.researcher_notes: Fuel=Gas supported: Hawiyah plant processes Khuff non-associated (dry) gas; a Khuff-gas line to Hawiyah carries gas, not NGL.

Owner=Saudi Aramco corroborated: offshore-technology/GlobalData names Saudi Aramco as owner/operator of the Haradh-Hawiyah gas line; Saudipedia confirms Aramco operates the Hawiyah plant and its Master Gas System feeders.

Status=operating could not be independently confirmed for THIS specific line. The Hawiyah plant and Khuff-gas corridor are operating, but no independent source confirms a distinct 'line 3' is operating. Left UNRESOLVED pending duplicate resolution.
43 km not independently corroborated; the one independent industry figure (offshore-technology/GlobalData) gives 450 km for a Haradh-Hawiyah gas line. Conflict -> no ref staged.
30 in not independently corroborated; offshore-technology/GlobalData gives 36 in (max) for a Haradh-Hawiyah gas line. Conflict -> no ref staged.

summary: P1919 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 3): real Khuff->Hawiyah gas corridor & Aramco ownership confirmed, but flagged DUPLICATE (identical to P1917/P1918, no independent source distinguishes 3 parallel 43km/30in lines), ATTRIBUTION (province should be Eastern, not Makkah), and SPEC (43km/30in uncorroborated; independent source says 450km/36in).
